Day 1 March 7: travel from Indianapolis to Charlotte. Day 2 March 8: Charlotte. Day3 March 9: travel to Asheville. Day4 March 10: Asheville. Day5 March 11: travel to Raleigh. Day6 March 12: Raleigh. Day7 March 13: travel back to Indianapolis? Or end in Raleigh and travel back? The user didn't specify return. But it says week-long travel plan starting from Indianapolis and venturing through 3 NC cities. Probably return to Indianapolis on March 13. So day7: travel back to Indianapolis. So 7 days: travel days included.

We need to fill details. Transportation: maybe flight or bus. For simplicity: flight. Provide flight numbers and times. Use placeholders.

Breakfast: restaurant. Attraction: list multiple separated by semicolon.

Lunch/dinner: restaurant. Accommodation: hotel.

We need to keep within budget $6,500. We don't have to calculate exactly, just plausible. Use moderate hotels.

We need to call submit_day_plan 7 times.

Ensure each call includes day number 1-7, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to not ask follow-ups. So we need to produce the calls.

Day5: March 11: Travel to Raleigh. Transportation: "Car rental". Breakfast: "Bunbun". Attraction: "Travel to Raleigh". Lunch: "Sloppy Joe's". Dinner: "Ruth's Chris, Raleigh". Accommodation: "Hyatt Regency Raleigh".

Day6: March 12: Raleigh. Transportation: "Car rental". Breakfast: "The Flying Biscuit, Raleigh". Attraction: "North Carolina Museum of Art, Raleigh; Pullen Park, Raleigh". Lunch: "Good Food on 5th, Raleigh". Dinner: "The Cowfish, Raleigh". Accommodation: same.

Day7: March 13: Travel back to Indianapolis. Flight: Flight IA456, depart 12:00, arrive 14:30. Breakfast: "On board". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "-". Dinner: "-". Accommodation: "-" (end).

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
